regimes.synthetic: oracle_geometry pose-token controls, not rendered perception

disclosures: W144 results and source sheets already known; no W145 official model output, conditioning statistics or synthetic-sequence outcomes yet.

First declaration followed a unit run with 15 pass / 1 fail: a true 30deg turn from frontal projection moved hips less than the declared 2px support cutoff, so it abstained. Algorithm, thresholds and experiment gates are UNCHANGED. The clear-turn unit fixture now starts obliquely; a separate test explicitly requires abstention for the ambiguous frontal 30deg turn. Original declaration is retained.
No source-wide constant side-facing assumption. Diagnostic qualification emits null instead of propagating a held pose. It is not a repair or full temporal orientation estimator.

perturbations.directions: one joint, one Cartesian axis, both signs; all 240 frames
perturbations.analytic: differentiate normalization/projection/cross product; central finite difference epsilon=1e-6 m; report operator spectral norm in deg/mm, conditioning and invalidity separately
perturbations.directions_2d: each direct joint, x/y, +/-; all 240 frames, fixed cached crop vs recomputed crop; derived midpoints updated
source_interventions: forward/back-valid LK texture endpoints for hips/shoulders only
perturbations.texture: frozen W144 LK diagnostics: 21px, 3 levels, 30 iterations, epsilon .01, min eigen1e-4, FB<=1px; texture is not anatomical GT

s0_cpu.if_mismatch: retain diagnostic response as CPU numerical variant; do not claim exact frozen-output attribution; no S1 correction eligibility from incompatible model

qualifier.purpose: single frozen measurement-qualification diagnostic; no repaired matrices for unqualified frames
qualifier.logic: geometric sensitivity / original frame validity / input visibility / texture disagreement / unconfirmed large depth turn on quiet source; no max turn speed, smoothing or hold

synthetic.projection: orthographic diagnostic image x=320+100*X, y=240-100*Z; camera stationary. Pose-token controls; simulated texture is oracle-projected point motion, explicitly not rendered/perceived.
synthetic.truth: known pelvis orientation and independent torso orientation; no synthetic root/GT supplied to authentic S1

gates.real_thresholds: full 240 source identity; no new unexplained flip; preserve genuine motion/source timing; source-visible evidence required independently, not displacement-only

candidate_eligibility: No real-rig corrected candidate unless diagnosis AND all appropriate synthetic turn/false-flip/ambiguity/pelvis-torso controls support a specific independently source-constrained replacement. Measurement abstention alone is not an Action. At most one candidate; any algorithm/parameters declared in an additive prospective protocol BEFORE its outcomes, no sweeps.
classification: SUPPORTED: validated mechanism + useful source-consistent real Blender candidate; PARTIALLY SUPPORTED: useful conditioning/attribution but fidelity/generalization/observability unresolved; NOT YET SUPPORTED: tested approach does not establish reliable improvement; BLOCKED: prerequisite prevents valid experiment.
